realBugs.details: Clicking 'Use a password' on chooser does NOT navigate to screen-password. Confirmed across 5 flows: password-happy, password-wrong, password-account-locked, password-identifier-first, password-forgot.
Clicking 'Get a one-time code' on chooser does NOT navigate to screen-otp/request. Confirmed across otp flows.

screen-password/error → screen-account-locked has no button path. Account-locked transition is likely auto-triggered after 3rd wrong attempt — needs to be marked trigger:'auto' OR the wrong-password handler needs to detect attempts and dispatch.
Save new password button on screen-new-password does NOT navigate to screen-reset-success.
No button on screen-otp/default reaches screen-otp-no-access. 'Can't access this code? Get help' link href='#' likely doesn't have handler.

workingCorrectly: wrong-password 3-strike error display (idx-based buttons confirmed reach error state)
forgot password link in password screen → forgot-password
verify-btn / resend-btn from otp/default reach otp/wrong
